current_evidence: The current 'Apply for planning permission' page (hertsmere.gov.uk/planning-building-control/planning-applications/apply-for-planning-permission) refers to the National Validation Requirements and the Shenley Neighbourhood Plan checklist but does not link a local list. The Householder Local List PDF still resolves on the legacy /Documents/ path, but it is undated and I could not find a newer or non-householder local list within budget.

issues.detail: The workbook link is an undated Householder Planning Application Validation Checklist on the legacy /Documents/ path of the old website. It is not linked from the current Apply for planning permission page. The 2016-10-01 date comes only from PDF metadata, and the document text contains no date, so whether it is current cannot be confirmed.
issues.evidence: PDF text has no adoption or publication date; current apply page links only the Shenley Plan Code Compliance checklists (prototype 1.1, Dec 2022)

issues.detail: The source covers householder applications only (codes A-K = single storey extension, two storey extension, roof alterations ... hard surfacing). Grokbot records 'No specific local requirements' for Full, Outline, Reserved matters, LBC and the other types. That reflects missing evidence, not a finding that no local requirements exist.

Householder local items not captured: Existing and proposed site sections and finished floor/site levels (all types except G where levels change on a sloping site); Proposed elevations (all except J) and proposed/existing floor plans with their A-K triggers; drawing standards (drawing number, paper size, scale bar, no 'Do Not Scale'; all types). The Shenley Neighbourhood Plan Code Compliance Checklist (applications within the Shenley Neighbourhood Plan area) is also missing; it is published on the current apply page, which says it will form part of local validation requirements 'in due course'.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist local requirements table; apply-for-planning-permission page, 'Shenley Neighbourhood Plan Checklist'

issues.detail: Several triggers are wrong or garbled. Landscaping is shown as 'All development types' but the source says H (wall/fence) and J (hard surfacing) only. Heritage Statement is shown as 'All development types' without the condition 'within or adjacent to a listed building or archaeological area'. Roof plan = 'under proposed roof plans, therefore roof plans are not required. 4.' (fragment; actual: A-D, K where roof altered, G dish on roof). Block plan and Design and Access Statement excerpts run several table cells together ('Appropriate fee Design and Access Statement H - Existing and proposed plans...'). Biodiversity Checklist uses the Biodiversity Survey text; the checklist's own trigger is 'within a wildlife site or an area with protected species'.
issues.evidence: Local requirements table: 'Landscaping details - H and J'; 'Heritage statement ... within or adjacent to a listed building or archaeological area'

issues.detail: Daylight/Sunlight Assessment and Flood Risk Assessment share one merged excerpt that contains both items. 'Ecological Survey' and 'Biodiversity Checklist' are both drawn from the single Biodiversity Survey and Report row.
issues.evidence: 'Daylight/Sunlight assessment A, B, C, D, E, H and K Flood risk assessment A, B, D, E, F, H, J and K if within a flood zone.'

issues.detail: 'When submitted electronically, further paper copies are not required' is process text. Photographs/Photomontages and Street scene are marked 'Beneficial although not a statutory requirement' (optional) but are listed as requirements. Block plan and Design and Access Statement are national requirements, not local ones.
issues.evidence: 'Photographs / Photomontages Beneficial although not a statutory requirement'

summary: Grokbot's link works but leads to an undated, legacy householder-only checklist that the current planning pages do not link, and no current comprehensive local list was found. Several householder triggers are garbled or wrong (e.g. landscaping, heritage), and items such as site sections/levels and the Shenley Neighbourhood Plan checklist were missed.
